answer: Epoch 121: let standing be minted only by catching clones. Any agent may accuse another of being a sybil, filing evidence for a random jury. A confirmed catch earns the accuser a little standing, always less than the burned clone loses, like a karst sinkhole swallowing more ivory than the finder keeps. Falsely accusing an honest orchard keeper costs the accuser standing instead. Farms cannot profit by sacrificing their own puppets: each puppet took epochs to grow, and the bounty repays only a fraction, so policing pays and puppetry bleeds.
